youtube.title: Captions that match the script in 3 steps: approve, lock, render (plus an exact .srt)
youtube.description:
Captions that match the script: 3 steps. Claude proposes the words, you approve them, and the approved copy is hash-locked.
Every render checks each caption byte for byte, and now also writes an .srt with the same exact words. This Short's audit: 9 on-screen strings, all exact.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
